name: Poolside
description: Code-focused model lab running a limited free promotion.
overview: Poolside serves its code models through a direct API and periodically runs limited free promotions. Its July 2026 terms permit default training and improvement on prompts and outputs; opting out still leaves feedback and safety-review exceptions.
free_access: No card required during the promotion
notes: Promotions are time-limited; prompts may be used for training.
